purpose: Restate the eval-scoring cost under the expectation-decode estimator; the pre-flight Item-4 receipt was measured under argmax and is stale.

measured_local.config: canonical d512 (8L/512/1024/8h), seq_len=512, h=15, random weights (timing only)

chunk_64.note: expectation is ~1.2x FASTER than argmax here (decode_latent(E[z]) + softmax@grid is cheaper than decode_tokens per step on this hardware)

chunk_512_recipe.status: OOM on mps (19.69 GiB KV cache at batch 512 x 527 rollout steps > 20.13 GiB limit) - not measurable locally
chunk_512_recipe.implication: chunk=512 amortizes the 512-step context fill far better than chunk=64, so the chunk=64 rate is a FLOOR, not the operating point; the operating rate is PENDING the 4090

key_finding: The estimator change (argmax -> expectation) is NOT a throughput regression: measured expectation/argmax throughput ratio = 1.22 (expectation faster) on mps at the real config. The premise 'expectation-decode is slower per rollout step' is not borne out on the measured hardware (the extra per-step cost is offset by decode_latent being cheaper than decode_tokens).

real_scale_decision_count_h15_headline.basis: prereg s2 primary region (forward blocks 1-5), h=15 stride grid

labels_required_by_item_5.training_throughput: MEASURED on the real 4090 (prior toy-CUDA rehearsal): 47.2k bars/s -> full M6 ~ 2-3 GPU-days
labels_required_by_item_5.eval_leg: estimator is NOT a regression (measured ratio 1.22 faster); ABSOLUTE eval-scoring rate is chunk- and hardware-dependent (recipe pins chunk=512), PENDING the 4090 measurement in the re-run
labels_required_by_item_5.dollar_figure: spot-price dependent (~$0.26-0.40/hr on vast 4090); the banked '$20-30 / 2-3 GPU-days' is NOT quoted without these labels
